answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 193 Country: United Kingdom Title: Is working in a cinema permissible? Question: Is working in a cinema permissible? Answer ID: 193 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 186/M=182/M) The cinemas are centres of sins and other unlawful things which are either basically unlawful or cooperation on unlawful and both these things are haram in Shariah; the Quran says: But help ye not one another in sin and rancour, fear Allah; for Allah is strict in punishment. (5/2) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
